workspaceFiles.client.py:
import asyncio

import httpx


async def app(scope, receive, send):
    assert scope["type"] == "http"
    await send(
        {
            "type": "http.response.start",
            "status": 200,
            "headers": [(b"content-type", b"text/plain; charset=utf-8")],
        }
    )
    await send({"type": "http.response.body", "body": b"healthy"})


async def fetch_health() -> httpx.Response:
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(app=app, base_url="http://testserver") as client:
        return await client.get("/health")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    response = asyncio.run(fetch_health())
    print(response.status_code, response.text)

import runpy
import sys

installed = version("httpx")
if installed != "0.28.1":
    print(f"PREREQUISITE_VERSION_MISMATCH: expected httpx 0.28.1, got {installed}", file=sys.stderr)
    raise SystemExit(126)
runpy.run_path("client.py", run_name="__main__")
verification.testSuite:
import asyncio
from importlib.metadata import version

from client import fetch_health

assert version("httpx") == "0.28.1", "exact HTTPX 0.28.1 is required"
response = asyncio.run(fetch_health())
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.headers["content-type"] == "text/plain; charset=utf-8"
assert response.text == "healthy"
assert response.request.url == "http://testserver/health"
